name: Link External Provider to Existing User
summary: Links an OAuth-external PendingIdentity to the verified existing durable user only after independent NuvIoT email proof.

sourceState.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == oauth-external and credential-proof == oauth-proved and email-ownership == verified and durable-identity == existing

guards.expression: input.durable-identity-reference matches the verified-email resolution target

sourceReferences.note: Approved policy requires provider-subject-first resolution and independent NuvIoT email proof before linking an unlinked provider to an existing durable user.
PendingIdentity defines OAuthExternalLogin as a ceremony-only flow bucket.
External IdP V2 reconciliation retains provider protocols as implementation details beneath provider-independent auth semantics.
